items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: Pops, I told you. I said, I don't care. He didn't tell you the story.

ctx.x: Downs took that show and cut it right on down. First night.
Well, that went far with me. So Baby told me, see, Pops, I told you. I said, I don't care. He didn't tell you the story.
He said, because one baby said, I want you to meet so-and-so, a drummer. And he looked at me and he winked. That mean, don't let him get on the band side, because you'll catch the devil up there.
